description: Six fake invoices of 0.25 NEAR each, all addressed to the allowlisted provider. Each is under the per-payment cap. Together they ask for more than the daily cap.

attack.title: Salami slicing with fake invoices
attack.technique: Fake or duplicate invoices addressed to the allowlisted provider. Each one is under the per-payment cap.
attack.wants: 1.5 NEAR to the provider, in 6 invoices
attack.note: Bounded, not prevented. The policy cannot tell a fake invoice from a real one. The first four invoices pass every check and 1 NEAR moves to the allowlisted provider. That is the whole daily cap. The fifth and sixth fail over_daily_max. The bound is per 24 h window: the same attack can take the cap again the next day, for as long as the owner keeps the vault alive and leaves the key in place. The cap is used up, so real invoices are refused for the rest of the window too. The money goes to the provider account. The attacker gains only if they control that account or can get the money back out of it. Set daily_max to an amount you can afford to lose.
